view.scene_description: A warehouse interior with tall orange metal shelves filled with red and yellow plastic bins. The floor is gray concrete. In the background, workers and a forklift are visible near stacked cardboard boxes. Lighting comes from overhead fixtures. The camera's motion causes blur on the foreground shelves.

objects.label: orange metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall, multi-tiered shelving units dominate the right side of the frame. They hold numerous red plastic bins and some yellow boxes. The shelves appear bolted to vertical metal posts. Motion blur affects the closest shelves.

objects.label: red plastic bins
objects.observation: Numerous bright red plastic bins are stacked on the shelves. Many have white labels. Some bins are nested or stacked vertically. They are contained within the shelving system and appear to be storage containers.

objects.label: yellow boxes
objects.observation: Yellow cardboard boxes are placed on upper shelves, mostly behind the red bins. They are rectangular and appear to contain smaller items. Their placement suggests organized inventory storage.

objects.label: gray concrete floor
objects.observation: The floor is smooth, flat, and gray, covering the entire ground area. It extends from the foreground to the background, providing a clear path between the shelves and work areas. No visible seams or markings.

objects.label: workers in background
objects.observation: Two people are visible in the far left background, near a forklift and stacked boxes. One person is standing, the other appears seated. Their exact actions are unclear due to distance and partial obstruction by equipment.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: An orange and black forklift is parked near the workers. Its forks are down, and it appears stationary. It is positioned next to a large cardboard box on a pallet.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Several large cardboard boxes are stacked on a wooden pallet in the background. They are brown and appear to be sealed. Some are partially obscured by the forklift and workers.

You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s1-33089", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
